notes: Verified via Wayback Machine snapshot of udyamregistration.gov.in. 3 pages, digital-native PDF. RBI Circular No. RBI/2020-2021/10 dated 2 July 2020, issued by FIDD (Financial Inclusion and Development Department), RBI. Notifies all Commercial Banks (incl. SFBs, LABs, RRBs), Urban/State/District Co-operative Banks, AIFIs, and NBFCs of the new MSME classification criteria per Gazette Notification S.O. 2119(E) dated 26 June 2020, effective 1 July 2020. Critical for PMEGP because the new MSME definition determines PMEGP eligibility thresholds. Filed under central-government/msme/notifications/ (alongside the MoMSME annual report) since RBI circulars on MSME classification are administered by MoMSME.
